reviewer: coverage_review subagent; independent runtime reviewer/test author
scope: Bounded trailing shared patients, shared local entity creation, archive/ledger/live-library interactions
evidence_kind: Development contract tests with actual RuleAssigner plus synthetic calibration and scripted model; not held-out accuracy.

independent_finding.source: Create and launch Alpha, then inspect Alpha.

before.problem: Global literal-to-ID grounding from final inspection leaked into newly created/shared Alpha mentions.

independent_finding.fix: Knowledge helper detects literal used both for newly created description and prospective live binding, adds knowledge_conflicting_mention_roles:Alpha and removes global binding.

coverage: one entity across two/three predicates and later them
source span preserved outside receiving predicate chunk
quantity copied with exact source literal
plain and does not assert temporal sequencing
custom action vocabulary alone cannot authorize shared pattern
creation provenance blocks live binding for all shared and later local-pronoun frames
archive stays lexical and full prior history retained
AI cannot forge trusted creation provenance to suppress live ambiguity
remaining_limits: Shared-patient patterns are explicit supported construction profiles, not general English valency proofs.
Learned parser remains involved in NP/role extraction.
Shared modifiers, argument scope and nominal coordination are unsupported in this rule.
Bindings remain keyed by literal; per-frame/per-span binding contract is still needed for general repeated-mention disambiguation.
Archive/library snapshots remain caller-attested; no automatic refresh/persistence or complete legacy migration.
No new empirical calibration, fresh corpus, or model accuracy was measured.
